history.summary: A freehold 1,463 sqft 2BR at a headline-cheap $1,059 psf (39% below the $1,742 median) in a tiny 46-unit Kallang development, 750m from Potong Pasir MRT. The freehold tenure and absolute size are attractive, but only 46 units and 15 URA transactions make this acutely illiquid, the odd 1,463 sqft 2BR likely reflects a strata/layout anomaly, and the 7.5% CAGR rests on a statistically thin sample. Too much exit and data risk for an investment hold.
history.rating_rationale: On paper the PSF discount and freehold tenure look compelling, but the discount is largely an artifact of (a) a 46-unit boutique block with essentially no liquidity and (b) an anomalously large 1,463 sqft '2BR' that distorts the per-sqft comparison versus the 1,742 median (which is dominated by normal-sized units). Only 15 URA transactions means both the median and the 7.5% CAGR are statistically unreliable, and 750m to Potong Pasir is a soft MRT link. For a 5-7 year investment where exit liquidity is critical, a 46-unit/15-txn asset is the textbook illiquidity trap. The freehold and low absolute price don't compensate. Avoid.
red_flags: Only 46 units — boutique block, structurally illiquid with thin amenities
Just 15 URA transactions — median PSF and 7.5% CAGR both statistically unreliable
1,463 sqft for a 2BR is anomalous — likely layout/strata quirk inflating the apparent PSF discount
750m to Potong Pasir MRT is a weak connectivity link versus batch peers
catalysts: Low absolute price ($1.55M) for a freehold city-fringe unit

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: City-fringe D12 has reasonable tenant demand, but a 46-unit block offers no facilities draw and the unusual large layout narrows the tenant fit. Rental serviceable, not a strength.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: The 7.5% CAGR is built on only 15 transactions and is not dependable. Freehold provides a floor, but illiquidity will suppress realized appreciation and widen the bid-ask on exit.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA 7.5% CAGR disregarded as statistically thin (15 txns); reverting to a conservative freehold city-fringe rate given illiquidity

history.summary: A 388 sqft freehold shoebox asking $720k / $1,856 psf — roughly 6% ABOVE the last same-size print in the project (388 sqft at $1,752 psf / $680k) and above the entire 12-month transacted range ($1,079-$1,703 psf). Under current priors the only validated forward edges are cheap-vs-same-size-peers (fails: priced at a premium) and region (D12 RCR +3.1%, generic). Freehold is no forward edge. Gross yield ~3.8-4.3% on realistic $2,300-2,600/mo rent is not enough to carry the exit risk of a sub-400sqft unit in a 46-unit boutique block (15 URA txns ever) in a Balestier market flagged for micro-unit oversupply and shoebox financing friction.
history.rating_rationale: Priced above verified same-size comps (no value edge under v3.4+ priors); thinnest-liquidity segment (sub-400sqft shoebox, 46-unit block, 15 lifetime URA txns); Balestier micro-unit oversupply/GFA-cap area with bank financing friction on shoeboxes; only tailwind is the generic D12 RCR region effect; ~4% gross yield does not compensate exit risk over a 5-7yr hold.
red_flags: Ask $1,856 psf vs last same-size 388sqft print $1,752 psf ($680k) — ~6% premium, not a discount
Ask sits above the entire 12-month transacted psf range ($1,079-$1,703, avg $1,391 mixed sizes)
Sub-400sqft shoebox: thinnest resale demand, some banks reluctant to finance, MOP/micro-unit oversupply in Balestier (one of nine GFA-capped areas)
Boutique 46-unit block with only 15 lifetime URA transactions — structurally illiquid, trailing 7.5% CAGR statistically meaningless (and trailing appreciation has ~0 forward power)
750m to Potong Pasir MRT — walkable but not transit-doorstep
catalysts: D12 RCR fringe region effect (+3.1%/yr realized forward) — the one validated tailwind
Low $720k absolute quantum keeps the entry-investor buyer pool nominally wide
Freehold tenure (optionality only; no forward return edge under full-panel backtest)
history.source: re-eval under v3.4.1+ priors (2026-06-11 loop iter 12; prior eval was a different 1,463sqft unit)
